info.title: epsitec-format
info.description: Line-based source text checks and fixes: C# comment reflow, indentation and initializer checks (a faithful port of the briefcases Python formatting scripts, validated by a golden oracle), plus encoding, line endings and whitespace driven by .editorconfig, Razor @code blocks, misplaced warning suppressions, the C# file header (copyright and author lines, attribution lines, copyright year), the C# comment style (two spaces after //, no long dashes, blank lines around the AAA markers, no spec reference), the C# XML doc comments (no doc comment on a test method, the opening of type summaries) and the line length against max_line_length; findings can also be written as JUnit and GitLab Code Quality reports, under an explicit exit policy (--fail-on, --tolerate); the severity of an identifier (none, suggestion, warning, error) is set per path with dotnet_diagnostic.<id>.severity in .editorconfig, an identifier is left out per run with --exclude-ids, and the comment wrap width is set with epsitec_comment_line_length. - 1.6.1.2639 net10.0

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: epsitec-format — line-based source text checks and fixes.

options.name: --fix
options.description: Apply fixable rules in place. Absent means check mode (no writes). [default: False]

options.name: --rules
options.description: Comma-separated subset of comments,indent,initializers,encoding,razor,suppressions,header,comment-style,xmldoc,layout. Absent means all ten.

options.name: --ids
options.description: Comma-separated FMT identifiers to check and fix (e.g. FMT0003). Absent means all.

options.name: --exclude-ids
options.description: Comma-separated FMT identifiers to leave out of the run, applied after --ids (e.g. FMT0024,FMT0026).

options.name: --extensions
options.description: Comma-separated file extensions the encoding and layout rules check (e.g. .md,.txt), replacing their default list.

options.name: --max-columns
options.description: Positive integer wrap width of comment prose. Absent means the epsitec_comment_line_length of .editorconfig, else 79.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the structured JSON report on stdout. Absent means a human-readable summary. [default: False]

options.name: --msbuild
options.description: Emit one build-tool diagnostic line per issue on stdout (path(line,1): info|warning|error FMTnnnn: title). [default: False]

options.name: --summary
options.description: Emit only the number of issues per FMT identifier and severity, without the file list. [default: False]

options.name: --changed
options.description: Check only the files listed in this file (one path per line), or on stdin with '-'. Replaces the targets. Also reports the diff-reach diagnostics.

options.name: --update-year
options.description: Check the copyright year of the changed files against the current year, and bring it up to date with --fix (requires --changed). [default: False]

options.name: --year
options.description: Year used by --update-year instead of the local clock (four digits).

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Which issues make the run exit 1: none, unfixable (report-only issues) or any. Absent means any in check mode and none in fix mode. An issue counts when its severity is above the --tolerate level.

options.name: --tolerate
options.description: Highest severity a successful run tolerates: none, suggestion, warning or error. Absent means warning: only an error makes the run exit 1.

options.name: --junit
options.description: Also write a JUnit XML report of the issues to this file.

options.name: --codequality
options.description: Also write a GitLab Code Quality report of the issues to this file.

arguments.name: TARGETS
arguments.description: Files, directories, or glob patterns to scan. Defaults to the current directory.
